audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty framing tells you to hold the wall for her entry and calls Shunpo a 'sidestep tool' to be burned; Shunpo is a 725-range blink to a target, which Crystallize cannot stop.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Katarina blinks to the target.' Terrain does not deny a blink. The wall's real value here is cutting her off from a dropped Dagger and from her walk-out after the channel.
audit.corrected: The lane is favoured (49.45% is close, but the chart is Anivia every row) because she has one entry — Shunpo, 12s at rank 1 — and your stun answers it. Wall the dagger, not the blink.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[5] is labelled 'First item' but whys[5] describes '2+ items', and no spike text names Katarina's actual timings.
audit.why: Her spikes are Shunpo rank-ups (12s to 8s) and Death Lotus at 6 falling from 75s to 45s, plus Voracity refunding everything on a kill. Yours are Lost Chapter, level 6, and Seraph's/RoA.
audit.corrected: Row 5 text realigned to the first-item timing; her ult cooldown named so the 'when not to fight' window is concrete.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single decisive interaction in this matchup is never stated: Death Lotus is a channel, so Flash Frost's stun ends it outright.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'Katarina becomes a flurry of blades, dealing massive magic damage while she channels.' Anivia holds a 1075-range AoE stun on an 11s cooldown against a 75s ultimate. Nothing on the page says this. Secondary: Voracity 'dramatically reduces' her cooldowns whenever a champion she damaged dies, so a kill anywhere near her refunds Shunpo.
audit.corrected: Hold Q for her channel — the stun ends Death Lotus and it is 75s down at rank 1. Never let her finish a kill beside you: Voracity hands the whole rotation back.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page mentions that her Dagger must be walked over to be picked up, which Crystallize can deny.
audit.why: Voracity's text conditions the slash on 'If Katarina picks up a Dagger', and Preparation tosses the Dagger to the ground — pickup is a movement, and her movement is what your wall stops.
audit.corrected: Crystallize between her and a fallen Dagger denies the pickup that powers her reset pattern.

audit.whatIsWrong: Katarina is referred to as male in winCon, tradeGood, tradeBad, loading, dontsFull[2].t and report[9].t. wants.foe[0] writes 'Bounce Blade' for Bouncing Blade.
audit.why: Wrong ability name flagged in packet.suspectNames and confirmed against the kit file; wrong pronouns read as machine-generated.
audit.corrected: Bouncing Blade, and feminine pronouns throughout.

edits.before: Threaten Q until Katarina burns his sidestep tool, land it, then E + auto and walk before the answer — chilled E double-damage is the whole trade.
edits.after: Hold Q for the moment she Shunpos in — the stun cancels Death Lotus outright, and a chilled target takes double from E. She has one entry and no second.

edits.before: Spamming Q on cooldown until you are out of mana with no stun threat left — that is when Katarina walks straight at you.
edits.after: Free-casting Q at her from range — it is 11s at rank 1, and she only needs it down once to blink 725 onto you with nothing in the way.

edits.before: - Katarina Shunpo: matchup-defining — Her blink to daggers and targets — hard CC during her resets and she folds. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Crystallize like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Shunpo: 12s at rank 1, 725 range, and it is a blink — Crystallize will not stop it. - Death Lotus: 75s at rank 1 and it is a channel, so your stun ends it. - Voracity refunds all of it on a kill, so never let her finish someone beside you.

edits.before: Tax every dive with stun-wall-tower math, then out-scale him into a teamfight he cannot enter. Shorthand: Shunpo down, wave right, go.
edits.after: Bank the stun for her channel — Death Lotus is 75s at rank 1 and any CC ends it. Shorthand: Shunpo spent, wave on your side, go.

notes: packet.suspectNames flagged two names: 'Bounce Blade' is a genuine error and is corrected to Bouncing Blade; 'Glacial Storm's' is a FALSE POSITIVE — that is Anivia's own R and it is spelled correctly. Two derived-flag misfires recorded and deliberately not used: Bouncing Blade carries a 'grounding' flag and Preparation carries a 'knockup' flag, neither of which appears in Riot's description of either ability (a bouncing dagger and a self move-speed buff). Death Lotus's antiHeal flag was checked and judged irrelevant — Anivia has no healing to reduce — so nothing was written about it per the relevance rule. Level chart agrees across both layers (all Anivia) and matches the packet; no chart edits needed.
